references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native shape: a tall thin man in a long dark blue cloak with a high collar, a tan waistcoat, dark trousers, pale face, dark hair, hands hanging.
Shipped The Master (crimson robe, staff): the master vampire wears a long INDIGO-BLUE cloak with a cream waistcoat, no staff, arms hanging.

prompt_fields.subject: A master vampire seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a tall gaunt pale-faced man with slicked dark hair and cold bright eyes, standing upright and calm in a long full-length cloak of bright cobalt royal blue with a high stiff collar lined pale sky-blue, the cloak lit with light periwinkle highlight planes on every fold, a large cream-white waistcoat and cravat clearly visible at the chest, mid-grey trousers, both arms hanging with long pale fingers. No staff, no fangs bared. Cold, aristocratic and complete, clearly lit.
prompt_fields.contrast: Vampire family, four grades: the master vampire is the tall calm INDIGO-BLUE cloaked figure with a cream waistcoat (silhouette: tall narrow upright column, straight cloak, arms hanging; hue: indigo blue with cream; value: mid). The lesser vampire is an orange-tunic young man, the vampire a crouching scarlet-caped figure, the elder vampire a hooded burgundy robe, and the shipped The Master a crimson robe with a staff.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: it was drawn too dark and too small to read at 48px next to the other undead tokens. This time the creature is clearly LIGHTER, with strong light highlight planes on the upper-left of every fold, plate and limb, and it fills about four fifths of the disc radius around the disc centre (the figure and all its equipment stay inside that circle), while the disc stays exactly at the reference lightness.
prompt_fields.palette: Bright cobalt royal-blue cloak lifted with light periwinkle folds and sky-blue lining, large cream-white waistcoat, pale skin, dark hair, mid-grey trousers; the cloak is mid-light overall and nothing on the body is near-black except the hair. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
